posts.title: The days after being put on a PIP (1)
posts.description: 12 October, Monday early AM I pulled myself out of bed, despite not wanting to, because it’s too early for me. I knew I didn’t sleep enough, because I was struggling to fall asleep from my fever and headache last night. posts.title: Taking a break from my committed relationship
posts.description: It’s finally come to this. I was really sad but it felt so empowering to ask him to move out temporarily. posts.title: Sitting on a “happy chair” forever?
posts.description: At the start of one of my undergraduate philosophy classes, my professor started with a thought experiment. It went like this — if there exists a “happy chair”, which you could sit in and just experience happiness and forget about all pains, sorrows, frustrations, etc. would you like to sit in this chair forever, until death?
